posts.hook: Same city, different methods — pick what fits.
posts.cta: Match your method in Settings → Prayer calculation, then verify locally — link in bio.
posts.caption:
Prayer times are calculated, not guessed. Your method and madhab shape what you see on screen.

EasySalah lets you choose calculation presets (including auto and named methods such as MWL, Umm al-Qura, and others in the app list) and Hanafi vs Shafi for Asr where applicable. Mosque minute offsets are available as Pro tooling for those who need finer alignment.

Always cross-check with your local masjid when it matters for your community — the app is here to support clarity, not replace local scholarship.

Swipe for three quick reminders before you change settings.

posts.hook: Zakat math, organized on your phone.
posts.cta: Use the Zakat tab as an on-device organizer — link in bio. Ask a scholar for rulings.
posts.caption:
Zakat season can feel like spreadsheets in your head.

EasySalah includes a guided Zakat calculator with profiles, currencies, and locales — computed on-device. It is built to help you organize assets and liabilities, not to issue fatwas. When in doubt, ask a qualified scholar you trust.

Bismillah — take one honest pass this week and make the next step easier.

Layout stays LTR across languages; strings are translated with consistent placement for a predictable experience.
